name: Bardaisan
contribution: A Syriac-speaking Christian writer and teacher with a Gnostic background, and founder of the Bardaisanites.

checks.lead: Bardaisan (11 July 154 – 222 AD; Syriac: ܒܪ ܕܝܨܢ, Bar Dayṣān; also Bardaiṣan), known in Arabic as ibn Dayṣān (Arabic: ابن ديصان) and in Latin as Bardesanes, was a Syriac-speaking Christian writer and teacher with a Gnostic background, and founder of the Bardaisanites.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
